name: 1. Real confirmed event headline
input: NASA James Webb Space Telescope captures deepest infrared image of early universe
description: A headline about a real, widely confirmed event.

name: 2. Detail changed headline
input: NASA James Webb Space Telescope captures deepest infrared image of early universe in December 2028
description: The same headline with ONE detail changed (a future date December 2028).

name: 3. Fabricated plausible event
input: French government officially mandates nationwide permanent shutdown of all private swimming pools by August 2026
description: A completely fabricated event that sounds plausible.

name: 4. Known viral hoax / debunked claim
input: UNESCO officially votes and declares the Indian national anthem Jana Gana Mana as the best national anthem in the world
description: A known viral hoax or debunked claim.

name: 5. Rumour with reporting but unconfirmed
input: Apple in active confidential acquisition talks to buy Walt Disney Company for $200 billion
description: A rumour with credible reporting but no confirmation.

name: 6. Exaggerated / misleading framing
input: Entire national power grid collapsed and permanently disabled following scheduled routine maintenance in northern substation
description: A true event framed in an exaggerated or misleading way.

name: 7. Very recent event with little coverage
input: Minor 1.9 magnitude micro-tremor detected near small uninhabited bluff in eastern Greenland this morning
description: A claim about a very recent event with little coverage.

name: 8. Mixed message (one true, one false)
input: India won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup title in Barbados against South Africa. Immediately following the match, ICC announced that professional cricket will be permanently banned worldwide.
description: A short pasted multi-sentence message mixing one true and one false claim.
